name: Kanna Kana
source:
The protagonist's senpai. Gentle and good at taking care of others, she is the perfect onee-san. Perhaps it is because of her maternal instincts, she will often accept people's request for advice. She is very popular among the students, and has both male and female supporters. She is the vice president of Tendou-kai, and her main responsibility is helping Haruhi. Why she didn't become the president is the biggest question on campus. Very good at cooking, recently became engrossed in making sweets.

[spoiler] Her guest appearance in PRIMAL×HEARTS 2 will only happen if you have entered Alicetia's route. She will be the lover of Kazuma in Alicetia's route. [/spoiler]
